name: Quantum Lotus Lagoon
description: A serene lagoon where lotus flowers bloom with quantum‑entangled petals that shift colors with each ripple.
prompt: A tranquil lagoon at night reflecting a star‑filled sky. Giant lotus flowers float on the surface, each petal shimmering with iridescent, shifting colors that change as gentle ripples pass. Bioluminescent fireflies hover above. Photorealistic, detailed water reflections, 8k.
caption: Ripples rewrite reality in this quantum garden. 🌌🪷
